cases.description: Outer, inner, then event; independent fields survive.

Arrays replace completely.

Integer winner replaces an array without coercion.
Absent event attributes retain scope values.
Empty event attributes retain scope values.
Absent scope attributes do not suppress event values.
Keys use ordinal equality with distinct casing.
Canonically equivalent spellings are distinct ordinal keys.
Absent/blank event identifier falls back to innermost nonblank scope.
Absent/blank event identifier falls back to innermost nonblank scope.

Trim identifier boundaries without case folding or normalization.
